questions.question: The grimoire you receive at fifteen opens for the first time. What do you hope is inside?

options.text: A rare talent I can polish until it is perfect
Whatever it is, I will outwork it and make it mine
A spell that gets people safely from here to there
A lot of raw power, and time to learn to steady it

questions.question: Your squad is badly outnumbered. What is your move?

options.text: Charge in first and shout so every eye is on me
Get everyone out the back way, then follow
Pick the biggest opponent myself, grinning
Wait for a clear shot, then strike clean

questions.question: Which seat do you take in the squad?

options.text: Captain, with the loudest laugh at the table
Right hand of the captain, always watching their back
The one who gets people home, unnoticed until it matters
The best student, with everyone expecting results

questions.question: How do you deal with your own temper?

options.text: It flares, I shout, and ten minutes later it is gone
I bottle it up, and the power leaks out anyway
I laugh and turn it into a dare
I cool down and look for a smarter way

questions.question: Someone beats you at the thing you trained for. You:

options.text: Train twice as hard tomorrow and say so out loud
Call them a rival and a friend in the same breath
Blame my nerves and feel awful about it
Shrug, I was thinking about dinner anyway

questions.question: Which part of a mission would you want to own?

options.text: The flashy finish, with the biggest explosion
Making sure the whole team gets home
Telling the crew to go further than they think they can
The plan, worked out in advance

questions.question: After a long day on duty, what do you want most?

options.text: A giant meal and a loud table full of friends
A quiet corner and a long bath to myself
A fast ride somewhere with a view and no rules
One more round of training before bed

questions.question: What would you most like people to say about you?

options.text: That I never quit, whatever anyone said
That I had real talent and used it well
That I had their back when it counted
That I was wild enough to be worth following

profile: You were dealt a weaker hand than most, and you decided that was no reason to aim lower.
You make up for missing magic with raw strength and stubborn training, aiming for the kingdom's top job.
You take a tough captain's advice to heart and keep pushing past what you thought were your limits.
You have a gift that people notice at once, and a natural talent for riding the wind.
You share a big dream with your closest rival, who is also your best friend.
You are aiming for the top job in the kingdom, side by side with the person who pushes you hardest.
You come from a famous family, and you found a squad that took you in.
You have a huge amount of power inside you, and at first you could not keep it under control.
Something from your childhood left a mark, and you are learning to master your gift one day at a time.
You are the captain of your own crew, and nobody has to guess who is in charge.
You have a nickname that makes people nervous, and a knack for cancelling out anyone's best trick.
You teach by example that the only way to grow is to push past your limits.
You are the one who gets everyone where they need to go, with a gift for moving people through space.
You started out timid and careless, shaped by pressure from your family.
You are braver now than you used to be, and you are still growing into it.
You have a fiery temper and a loyal streak, and you stay at the side of the person who leads.
You throw fireballs in inventive ways, because one plain one is just not your style.
You travel on your own signature broom, and of course you have given it a name.
